agent_notes: Sarah's age (127, v1) is dated through Isaac: Sarah was 90 at his birth (Gen 17:17, 21:5 with Abraham 100), so she died when Isaac was 37, i.e. 37 years after anchor.isaac_birth. Gen 23 itself gives no age for Isaac. Rashi/Midrash link the death to the Akedah (Gen 22), which would put it soon after evt.gen_22 events (c. 2041 BCE); the date here (c. 2029 BCE) is about 12 years later than that, so the chain puts Isaac at 37 and Gen 22 at about 25. Kept the age arithmetic since the text states it; Isaac's age at Gen 22 is not stated.
